using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace SherpaOnnx
{
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    public struct OfflineDolphinModelConfig
    {
        public OfflineDolphinModelConfig()
        {
            Model = "";
        }
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPUTF8Str)]
        public string Model;
    }
}
